title: Wolf, Dog, Model
subtitle: Domestication vs breeding in AI training

chapters.title: Two Kinds of Choosing
chapters.blurb: Breeding aims at one trait; domestication makes living together possible, and comes first.

chapters.title: The Fox Farm
chapters.blurb: Belyaev's foxes were selected for tameness alone and changed in many other ways, though how far that generalizes is contested.

chapters.title: Three Layers of a Model
chapters.blurb: Pretraining as the wild animal, human feedback as domestication, verifiers as breeding, and the side effects that come with the package.

chapters.title: Leash or Colleague
chapters.blurb: Domestication runs both ways; values need checking from outside; the goal is a colleague, not an animal on a leash.
